title: Evaluation comparison commutes with derived inverse-limit projection
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_finiteEvaluation_projection
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (M : DerivedCategory (DiagonalSystems l X)) (n : ℕ) :
    p.limits.iso.hom.app M ≫ (p.LS.projection n).app (p.Rt.R.obj M) ≫
        (finiteEvaluationSquare l f p.Rt p.Rf n).iso.hom.app M =
      p.Rf.R.map ((p.LX.projection n).app M)

proof.text: Compare the two natural transformations from derived limit followed by derived direct image, using the composite universal derived unit. Derived-functor uniqueness reduces equality to the common unit on complexes.

Apply full normalization of the limit square and evaluation square. Naturality moves the tower direct-image unit across projection. On ordinary complexes, limit.post followed by a projection is direct image of that projection. The generic projection diagram assembles these equalities.
